children: Shares in Ashtead Technology rose after the company said it received a 498 million pound ($664.5 million) cash offer from private equity firm Ember Infrastructure Management.
London-listed shares closed 60.3% higher at 5.45 pounds following the announcement.

The subsea equipment rental provider said Wednesday that it is considering the unsolicited, non-binding indicative proposal, which is valued at 6.15 pounds per share. The company is currently providing Ember with preliminary information as part of the due diligence process.
The proposal follows three previous unsolicited and non-binding indicative proposals from Ember, the first two of which were unequivocally rejected by the board, it said.
"Shareholders are advised to take no action at this time," Ashtead said.
Under U.K. takeover rules, Ember has until Oct. 21 to make a formal offer or walk away, the company said. There is no certainty that an offer will be made or as to the terms of a potential offer.
